firstPlayerRule: Choose the starting player randomly, then take turns clockwise.
houseFallback: If everyone won the previous game, choose the next starting player randomly among all players.
clarifications: When playing multiple games, the player to the left of the previous winner starts. If the previous game was tied, randomly choose among the players who did not win.
